title: UPPERCUT
blurb: Up + heavy. Launch. Master rank adds hang-time and points.

title: ROUNDHOUSE
blurb: After two lights, heavy. The kick is the invoice.

title: FACE STOMP
blurb: Three stomps on a crushed skull. Smash, pop, splash. Brain on three.

title: SPEED VAULT
blurb: Vector called. Hands on the rail, legs through. Easy path is just-jump.

title: KONG / CAT PASS
blurb: Dive the hands. Harder. More points. The Son teaches this for money.

title: DASH VAULT
blurb: Dash into the rail. One foot, one lie about grace.

title: LANDING ROLL
blurb: Vector+. High drop, down or dash on contact. Converts fall into speed.
